description: Save an edited image (image_base64) as a new child result of parent_generation_result_id. Changes no existing result.

file_name.description: Optional filename for the saved retouched image

image_base64.description: Retouched image encoded as base64 or an image data URL

mime_type.description: Optional image MIME type; inferred from a data URL or defaults to image/png

operations.description: Optional retouch operation metadata stored with the child result

parent_generation_result_id.description: Generation result ID of the original image

name: mcp_save_retouch
title: Save Retouched Image
